# Zirve

> Zirve is a free logic puzzle game for iPhone and iPad by mm-apps, an independent developer in Türkiye. Climb a tower where every floor is a short timed puzzle from 11 types.

Zirve: Logic Puzzle Tower is a free iPhone and iPad game by mm-apps (Türkiye), released 10 November 2026.

## Facts
- Platforms: iPhone, iPad (iOS/iPadOS 18 or later)
- Price: free; optional gem packs
- Ads: no forced or interstitial ads; rewarded ads only when the player chooses (lives, continue, double chest)
- Puzzle types: 11 (Color match, Path draw, Block fit, Memory, Flow, Pipe turn, Color sort, Arrows, Gates, Lookouts, Lights)
- Modes: tower with camps every 10 floors; daily tower (same 10 floors for everyone, 3 tries); weekly leagues (7 tiers)
- Accessibility labels declared on the App Store: VoiceOver, Voice Control, Larger Text, Sufficient Contrast, Reduced Motion, Differentiate Without Color Alone
- Languages: Türkçe, English, Deutsch, Français, Italiano, Español
- Current version: 1.0
- Not available in: mainland China, Brazil, Russia, Belarus App Stores
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6823998367
- Last updated: 2026-11-12
